educationalGoal:
学習・教育目標
This course is an introductory course to help students develop the four basic skil
ls of communication (reading, writing, speaking, and listening) in modern Japanese
. Students will learn the Japanese writing system (hiragana & katakana), fundament
al grammatical structures of Japanese, and practice simple conversational skills s
uch as self-introductions. Students will also learn and practice basic phrases use
d in daily class time activities.
advice:
The class will be conducted using the following topics:

Greetings
Numbers
Lesson 1 New Friends
Lesson 2 Shopping
Lesson 3 Making a Date
